notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Shifters!

First of all, we want to thank you for your numerous bug reports, keep up the good work!

[b]The following changes and fixes have been made in this update:
[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that sometimes the goal of a Level was invisible
[*]Fixed that Secret Level 5 could not be completed
[*]Fixed the counter in Arcade to show the correct score after 10000 points
[*]Fixed the next level unlocking when the secret exit was reached
[*]The texture of the bridges has been changed
[*]By pressing the space bar in the Game Over menu you can now restart the level
[*] Added an option to set the jump button in the options menu
[/list]
We are also aware that the Achievements are not behaving properly and we are working on a solution.

[b]If you encounter any bugs or loss of progress feel free to contact us through our support:
krobgames@gmail.com
[/b]
